name: Email Entry to Passkey
summary: The user enters an email address, chooses Passkey, and the client opens the passkey continuation view without yet contacting the server.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email is visible

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Email address used to resolve the expected durable account when the passkey ceremony begins. Choosing Passkey does not itself reveal whether the account or a passkey exists.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.passkey is visible and the normalized email is retained in client authentication flow state

sourceReferences.note: Angular stores the email login seed and navigates to auth.continue.passkey from action:continue-passkey.
React Native stores the normalized email in AuthFlow state and navigates to the passkey challenge route.
Direct Passkey-first discovery from Welcome is deferred from launch scope. Passkey Sign In begins after email collection.
